notes: Vanilla Subtlety at 60 opens from stealth with Premeditation into Ambush for two free combo points plus a big opener hit, then keeps Hemorrhage's bleed applied (it is the talent-granted combo builder this tree gets in place of Sinister Strike) and weaves in Ghostly Strike on its own cooldown, spending five combo points on Eviscerate the same as the other two rogue specs. No Combat- or Assassination-specific preset exists upstream for this either, so the priority order is adapted from the shared rogue preset's finisher logic plus the community rotation order (Hemorrhage upkeep first, Ghostly Strike on cooldown, Eviscerate at five). Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

priorityList.notes: Keep Slice and Dice up so every combo point spent on it is not wasted swing time.
Ghostly Strike on cooldown: cheaper energy than Backstab and applies its own attack power debuff.
Hemorrhage as the combo point builder: Subtlety's talent-granted replacement for Sinister Strike, and its bleed needs reapplying once its charges run out.
